messages:
alex chan: Heads up — CI is failing on the GPU helm chart in the gitops deploy job. argocd is rejecting the rendered manifest.
maria g: saw that earlier. error in the lint step? can you paste the failing bit from the job log?
alex chan: yeah: `rendered manifest: patch merge: cannot merge map into null` from our helm templating helper. Happens when `gpu` block is omitted in values.
jeff li: guessing `merge`/`deepCopy` logic in _helpers.tpl; we coalesce with `| default {}` in a few places but one path uses `| default nil` and then we call `-` on it.
samir r: this one's tricky because our values.schema.json uses anyOf for the gpu profile, and the linter (helmfile/ct) validates before the template transforms. if values.json doesn't include `gpu: {}` the template ends up rendering `null` for nodeSelector.
alex chan: minimal repro in chart: ```yaml
# _helpers.tpl
{{- define "nodeSelector.merge" -}}
{{- $base := .Values.nodeSelector -}}
{{- $gpu := .Values.gpu.nodeSelector | default nil -}}
{{- if $gpu }}{{- merge $base $gpu | toYaml }}{{- else }}{{- toYaml $base }}{{- end }}
{{- end }}
```
maria g: aha — `default nil` -> `merge` expects maps. If `.Values.nodeSelector` is nil, `toYaml` emits `null` and some kustomize patches choke. change to `| default dict`?
jeff li: recommend `| default (dict)` or `merge (default dict)`. also update values.schema to not allow anyOf that makes nodeSelector optional in a way that breaks consumers.
infra-bot: CI job `ct-helmfile/gpu-chart` reported: exit code 1. See https://ci.internal/redwood/12345
samir r: quick fix PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/charts/pull/789 — adds `| default (dict)` and a small unit test in `test/values` to ensure omitted gpu block still renders valid yaml.
alex chan: thanks. can we also add a lint rule to fail if templates produce `null` top-level objects? last week we had a prod rollout where `null` made it to k8s and caused nodeAffinity to disappear.
maria g: +1. I'll add a check in the gitops pipeline: after `helm template` we run `yq eval 'select(. == null) | length'` and fail if any top-level document is `null`.
jeff li: and add a note in the chart README about GPU opt-in behaviour and the kube labels we expect (e.g. "redwood.com/gpu: nvidia-t4").
alex chan: PR merged to staging branch, monitoring the argocd sync. if anything else pops up ping me.
jeff li: once staging is green we'll backport to main and bump chart version. :thumbsup:
samir r: filing a small infra ticket to add the `ct` test case to the flakiness board so we know if similar template drift happens in other charts. ticket #INF-442
alex chan: thanks team. saved a few missed rollouts tonight. :coffee:
